test_title: PYST 31: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 28 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (3)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**develop**" means to create, build, or improve something.
 
• The Deep Ocean Mission aims to explore deep-oceanic resources and **develop** technologies for their sustainable use, suggesting the creation and improvement of such technologies.
 
• The other options: "forsake," "shrivel," and "celebrate" do not fit the context of advancing and creating new technologies.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The Deep Ocean Mission aims to explore deep-oceanic resources and develop__ technologies for their sustainable use.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Forsake:** to abandon or give up.
 
• **Shrivel:** to wither or become shrunken.
 
• **Celebrate:** to mark an occasion with festivities.
